text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was little time between the Tenno Sho (Autumn)
and the Japan Cup. I had Gentildonna rest
to recover from the fatigue of the race.
choice_data_list: (I'll grow stronger in the meantime!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Devising the most efficient training menu possible within the limited time,
and making adjustments right up to the very last minute—
choice_data_list: (I want more, so much more power...!)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I knew it,
you were over here.
choice_data_list: Huh, weren't you supposed to be resting?
Huh, weren't you taking a break?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Of course,
I was granted plenty of time.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
A fashion house I fancy
just launched a line of training wear.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I couldn't help but let my eyes wander. It looks like independent training is going to be even more enjoyable.
choice_data_list: I see, that's great.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: What about you?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Judging by your complexion,
I wouldn't exactly say you've been getting enough rest.
choice_data_list: I really want to be working right now.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
In that case, there's some additional work I'd like you to do.
choice_data_list: Tell me anything.
Tell me anything.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho. In that case, perhaps I shall make
a very difficult request of you.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: As I mentioned earlier, I got a little too carried away today...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I haven't had my tea yet. Would you
accompany your assigned Umamusume while she refreshes herself?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Such a deep sweetness...
Truly what one expects from an autumn Darjeeling.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Instead of dazing off like that,
why don't you have some too?"
choice_data_list: ...Were you just trying to give me a chance to catch my breath?
...Did you want me to take a breather?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I am no saint, you know.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "It looked like an unnecessary amount of pressure was put on you, so I thought I'd offer some advice."
choice_data_list: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If you keep fighting, you'll never be satisfied.
You just want to climb higher and higher...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
And—
I lose sight of where I currently stand.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"However, if you have made it this far as a Trainer
without ever training yourself—"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"I wrote you off
long ago."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I am not the kind of Umamusume with such poor taste
as to keep the powerless around as mere ornaments.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Even muscles need rest days.
Have the courage to make today that day.
choice_data_list: Gentil...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A wave of emotion welled up in my chest.
I could feel a gentle warmth in those words.
choice_data_list: ...Still, it's not enough yet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to acquire even greater strength,
worthy of being the Trainer to Gentildonna,
the strongest Umamusume...!
choice_data_list: How can I become even stronger?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I once asked my father
the exact same question.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna's father...
A wealthy man and an extraordinary figure of renown,
wielding immense influence across all sectors.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"That was right after I became old enough to understand things,
when I lost a race to my sister for the very first time."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
There certainly was a difference in physique.
However, the simple fact remains that I lost.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
To me, crushed by defeat,
Father shared a story of his own—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Born a commoner, Father established this house and built an unshakeable standing in just a single generation.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
At first, he was given nothing.
He was powerless—yet he possessed the right.
The right to claim power.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text:
"I was starved.
And that is why I attained extraordinary strength."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text: "Someone once said power is a cruel goddess. She nestles up to the undeserving, yet never comes to those who desire her."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —"However, that is merely an excuse used by those who lack the courage to woo the Goddess."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: That the only ones worthy of possessing power are those who hunger for it and are prepared to pursue it at any cost.
choice_data_list: Resolution...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"The day you wished to become strong was the day
you stepped onto the starting line of the struggle."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It will haunt you for the rest of your life.
If you still wish to move forward—are you prepared for that?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She looks at me with a steadfast gaze. "Resolve"...
Something I have steeled within my gut countless times before.
Yet right now, in this moment, it took a solid, undeniable shape.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Ordinary strength is not enough. You want to reach
even greater heights... The resolve to face that desire
and keep fighting—... If so, then!"
choice_data_list: Of course I have one!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, desire it.
Remain ever hungry."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Seize it.
—The power you seek.
choice_data_list: And... to the strongest of them all

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if that is truly what you desire...
then that makes you my enemy as well.
choice_data_list: ...That's true, there can only be one strongest.
...That's true, there's only one who can be the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Well, this is quite a predicament.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
However... that wasn't an answer
that could be reached so simply, either.
choice_data_list: Tell me.
Tell me.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Only one can become the strongest. However, strength exists in many different forms.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Everyone taught me that through the races up to today.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Everyone hones their own strength...
clashing against one another in fierce competition.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Every time, I encounter a new strength...
And yet—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
“There can only be one winner. The victor's power is absolute...
That is why racing is so beautiful.”

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...Even if it lacks the clarity of a race,
surely you have your own means as well."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Father used every means at his disposal to unite everything into one magnificent force.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder what you will do.
I wonder what you will draw strength from..."
choice_data_list: I'll definitely find it and prove it.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Yes, I look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —In the not-so-distant future.
